item.name: Welding Cutter
item.description: A maintenance tool that doubles as a close-range weapon. It can cut through thin metal, remove obstacles, or burn enemies at short range.

item.name: Shock Baton
item.description: A non-lethal security weapon that delivers controlled electrical bursts. It is useful against human enemies, small creatures, and low-grade drones, but weak against heavily armored targets.

item.name: Pips Welding Arm
item.description: An attachment that lets Pip repair machinery, cut through panels, or assist in combat.

item.name: Sonic Emitter
item.description: A directional acoustic weapon that emits focused sound pulses. It is effective against swarms, glass wolves, spore creatures, and enemies that rely on vibration or sensitive hearing.

item.name: Pulse Pistol
item.description: A standard civilian-grade energy pistol. Reliable, lightweight, and easy to maintain.

item.name: EMP Grenade
item.description: A throwable device that releases a short-range electromagnetic pulse. It disables drones, weakens synthetics, and interrupts digital defenses, but may damage friendly machine NPCs or reduce reputation with the Machine Parish.

item.name: Rail Carbine
item.description: A military-grade magnetic rifle that fires dense metal slugs at extreme velocity. It deals high damage against armored enemies but consumes rare ammunition and produces a loud firing signature.

item.name: Spore Bomb
item.description: A biological grenade cultivated by the Children of the Signal. It releases a cloud of reactive spores that can blind, poison, distract, or mutate organic enemies depending on the environment.

item.name: Null Blade
item.description: A rare alien-edged weapon that disrupts both physical matter and digital constructs. It can damage causality phantoms, hostile AIs, alien sentinels, and shielded enemies normally resistant to conventional weapons.

item.name: Dockworker Vest
item.description: A padded utility vest reinforced with thin impact plates. It offers light protection and several storage pockets.

item.name: Synthetic Interface Hood
item.description: A neural-shielded hood used when entering machine networks or hostile digital spaces. It reduces mental feedback from corrupted AI systems.

item.name: Drone Armor Plating
item.description: Protective plating that improves Pips durability during combat and hazardous exploration.

item.name: Insulated Suit
item.description: A sealed maintenance suit designed for electrical, coolant, and chemical hazards. It protects the user in the Lower Maintenance Ring and coolant overflow chambers.

item.name: Bio-Seal Mantle
item.description: A flexible cloak treated with anti-spore enzymes. It reduces damage from toxic gases, fungal attacks, and biological hazards in the Silent Gardens.

item.name: Helix Shield Belt
item.description: An experimental corporate energy shield worn around the waist. It absorbs a limited amount of incoming energy or projectile damage before requiring recharge.

item.name: Voidwalk Harness
item.description: A mobility rig designed for vacuum, low-gravity, and unstable artificial gravity zones. It includes magnetic boots, emergency thrusters, and a short-duration oxygen supply.

item.name: Reinforced Salvage Rig
item.description: A rugged exoskeletal work frame used by professional salvagers. It improves carrying capacity, grants resistance to crushing hazards, and helps move heavy debris.

item.name: Emergency Ration Pack
item.description: A sealed packet of nutrient paste, water gel, and stimulant tablets.

item.name: Med Injector
item.description: A standard medical auto-syringe that rapidly seals wounds and stabilizes the player. Common but expensive.

item.name: Advanced Trauma Foam
item.description: A military-grade healing compound that fills wounds and hardens into temporary tissue support. Restores more health than a standard med injector.

item.name: Focus Tab
item.description: A small cognitive stimulant used by technicians and pilots. Temporarily improves hacking, puzzle-solving, or perception checks.

item.name: Synthetic Nerve Booster
item.description: A temporary cyberchemical enhancer that improves reflexes, reaction time, and combat speed. Overuse may cause tremors or neural feedback.

item.name: Shield Cell
item.description: A compact power cartridge used to recharge energy-based gear.

item.name: Battery Pack
item.description: A universal charge unit used for tools, scanners, drones, and small devices.

item.name: Anti-Toxin Ampoule
item.description: A chemical treatment that removes poison, spore infection, or coolant contamination.

item.name: Alien Alloy Shard
item.description: A piece of non-human material recovered from Meridian’s ancient foundation. It can upgrade weapons or open certain alien locks.

item.name: Alien Signal Residue
item.description: A strange luminous substance collected from rooms affected by the Meridian transmission.

item.name: Circuit Filaments
item.description: Fine conductive threads used in hacking tools, scanner upgrades, and machine-interface devices.

item.name: Drone Parts
item.description: Loose servos, rotors, plating, and sensor modules used to repair or upgrade companion drones.

item.name: Memory Glass
item.description: Transparent storage crystal used by old synthetic systems. It can preserve AI memories or enhance translation devices.

item.name: Null Filament
item.description: A rare material connected to the same technology as the Null Blade. It can enhance weapons against digital, shielded, or alien enemies.

item.name: Organic Circuitry
item.description: A hybrid biological-machine component found in the Silent Gardens. It is used for cult gear, biotech upgrades, and alien research.

item.name: Salvage Mesh
item.description: Flexible industrial material used for armor repair, tool crafting, and environmental suit upgrades.

item.name: Shield Capacitor
item.description: A rare power component used to improve energy shields or repair corporate equipment.

item.name: Repair Kit
item.description: A compact case containing sealant foam, wire clamps, diagnostic leads, and disposable micro-tools. It is used for simple mechanical repairs, restoring broken panels, patching damaged conduits, and completing early maintenance puzzles.

item.name: Contraband Scanner Jammer
item.description: A palm-sized device that emits false cargo readings. It can confuse customs scanners, hide illegal items, or mask the inventory from station authorities for a limited time.

item.name: Fusion Spanner
item.description: A heavy industrial tool that uses focused heat and magnetic torque to loosen fused bolts, cut through warped panels, and repair large machinery. It is required for advanced engineering tasks and can also serve as an improvised melee weapon.

item.name: Scanner Lens
item.description: A handheld optical device that reveals hidden wiring, radiation traces, concealed compartments, alien markings, and invisible energy distortions. It is especially useful in the Alien Foundation and abandoned residential decks.

item.name: Insulated Gloves
item.description: Thick, flexible gloves lined with superconductive safety mesh. They protect from electrical hazards and allow repairs to live conduits, sparking panels, and unstable power junctions.

item.name: Plasma Lockpicks
item.description: A black-market bypass tool that burns microscopic access channels through sealed locks. It can open high-security doors, cargo crates, and restricted compartments, though using it may leave evidence of tampering.

item.name: Weather Control Rod
item.description: A maintenance baton linked to the Silent Gardens environmental systems. It allows the player to trigger rain, mist, artificial sunlight, or wind currents in specific habitat rooms.

item.name: Logic Splinter
item.description: A shard of machine-coded reasoning extracted from an old synthetic archive. It can be used to solve AI dialogue puzzles, bypass digital locks, or stabilize corrupted machine minds.

item.name: Alien Translation Matrix
item.description: A crystalline computational lattice designed to interpret alien symbols, tonal patterns, and non-linear messages. Once acquired, it allows the user to understand ancient inscriptions.

item.name: Dockworker ID Badge
item.description: A low-level access badge found near the Docking Concourse. It grants entry to service corridors, freight lifts, and basic maintenance areas.

item.name: Executive Keycard
item.description: A high-security access card issued to Helix Dominion leadership. It opens executive lifts, private offices, and restricted research areas.

item.name: Sister Amarants Bloom Key
item.description: A living organic key grown by the Children of the Signal. It opens sealed root passages in the Silent Gardens and responds to alien spores.

item.name: Hales Security Override
item.description: A temporary access code granted by Officer Hale. It can disable minor security lockdowns or open police-restricted areas.

item.name: Decryption Spike
item.description: A one-use hacking device that forces open encrypted terminals or locked data caches.

item.name: Ghost Key
item.description: An illegal identity masking program. It allows temporary access to secure systems without leaving obvious digital traces.

item.name: Archive Passcode
item.description: A code sequence granting access to restricted records in the Server Cathedral or Station Archives.

item.name: Firewall Charm
item.description: A defensive software token used by machine priests. It protects the player from hostile AI intrusion during cyberspace sequences.

item.name: Neural Buffer
item.description: A protective implant or external device that reduces mental damage from hostile simulations, alien visions, or corrupted memory recordings.

item.name: Mnemonic Star
item.description: A broken alien artifact found beneath the Lower Maintenance Ring. It contains compressed memories from the civilization of Veyra and serves as the first major clue that Meridian Station is older and more dangerous than anyone believed.

item.name: Mnemonic Fragment I
item.description: A memory shard recovered near the Sealed Alien Hatch in the Lower Maintenance Ring. It reveals that the Meridian system was designed as a containment structure, not a habitat.

item.name: Mnemonic Fragment II
item.description: A memory shard hidden in the Silent Gardens. It contains biological records from Veyra and hints that the planets destruction was connected to experiments with life, memory, and causality.

item.name: Mnemonic Fragment III
item.description: A memory shard preserved in the Machine Parishs Server Cathedral. It reveals that machine intelligences were involved in sealing the Meridian Core.

item.name: Casual Thread
item.description: A shimmering strand of alien probability technology. It allows the rewriteing one major event.

item.name: Alien Seedcase
item.description: A sealed biological relic from Veyra containing dormant alien genetic material. It can heal the Silent Gardens, empower the Children of the Signal, become a corporate weapon, or help restore life to the dead planet.

item.name: Corporate Blackmail File
item.description: A collection of encrypted records proving that Helix Dominion knew about the alien signal before the station-wide power failure. It can be used to threaten Director Marr, expose Helix, or negotiate with station authorities.

item.name: Family Photo Locket
item.description: A small metal locket found in the Forgotten Residential Decks. It belongs to Officer Hales missing sister.

item.name: Evacuation Manifest
item.description: A damaged station record listing civilians trapped during the old residential deck disaster. It reveals that the evacuation failure was concealed by station leadership.

item.name: Synthetic Rights Charter
item.description: A legal document drafted by free synthetics in the Machine Parish. It can influence faction negotiations, unlock peaceful synthetic dialogue options, or reshape the stations political ending.

item.name: Machine Prayer Token
item.description: A small etched metal disc carried by peaceful synthetics. Presenting it marks the player as a trusted guest in the Machine Parish.

item.name: Helix Research Logs
item.description: Scientific records from the Corporate Spire documenting experiments on alien energy, biological mutation, and signal-based cognition. They provide leverage against Helix and reveal key lore.

item.name: Childrens Drawing
item.description: A faded drawing found in Schoolroom 9 showing Meridian Station, Veyra, and a black star beneath the ring. It suggests children saw signs of the alien signal before adults noticed.

item.name: Broken Departure Board
item.description: A salvaged panel from the Neon Bazaars old passenger terminal. Its final listed flight was never launched.

item.name: Old Jalens Maintenance Notes
item.description: Handwritten notes from a retired mechanic describing unexplained doors, impossible wiring, and machines that repaired themselves.

item.name: Cult Hymnal
item.description: A book of prayers used by the Children of the Signal. Some verses are original human writing, while others appear to be translated alien messages.

item.name: Synthetic Funeral Disk
item.description: A ceremonial storage wafer containing the final thoughts of a dead synthetic. It can be given to Archivist Lume or sold.

item.name: Veyran Star Map
item.description: An alien map showing routes through space that do not match current astronomy. It suggests Veyras civilization may have traveled through altered causality rather than normal space.

item.name: Station Authority Memo
item.description: A confidential memo ordering the residential deck disaster to be classified. It can be used as evidence against station leadership.

item.name: Bioluminescent Spores
item.description: Glowing spores harvested from the Silent Gardens. They can illuminate dark rooms, mark hidden paths, distract predators, or trigger plant-based mechanisms.

item.name: Black-Market Passphrase
item.description: A rotating spoken code used to access hidden vendors in the Neon Bazaar.

item.name: Coolent Patch
item.description: A gel-lined patch used to protect equipment from freezing or overheating. It can repair damaged suits or stabilize machinery.

item.name: Damaged Memory Core
item.description: A synthetic memory module recovered from destroyed machine citizens.

item.name: Drone Signal Booster
item.description: A device that extends command range, allowing Pip to scout rooms ahead of the player.

item.name: Encrypted Data Chip
item.description: A hidden storage device containing stolen corporate data. It can be delivered to Mira Voss, sold to Kaspian Lure, decrypted for evidence, or handed to Helix for a reward.

item.name: Maintenance Drone Core
item.description: A damaged control unit that can be installed into a broken utility drone.

item.name: Old Transit Token
item.description: A physical access token from the stations original transit system.

item.name: Pips Empathy Routine
item.description: A rare behavioral module that gives Pip more expressive dialogue and improves interactions with synthetic NPCs.

item.name: Pips Sensor Upgrade
item.description: An upgrade for Unit-6 “Pip” that allows it to detect hidden compartments, invisible hazards, and cloaked enemies.

item.name: Station Records Seal
item.description: An official authorization token used to access old disaster files.

item.name: Stolen Salvage Crate
item.description: A container of parts taken from Rikkas supply runners.

item.name: VANTAGE Memory Shard
item.description: A fragment of the rogue AIs missing memory. Each shard restores part of VANTAGEs personality.

item.name: Memory Recording
item.description: A neural experience file sold illegally in the Memory Den. Some recordings contain useful clues, while others are addictive or dangerous.

item.name: Rare Earth Cartridge
item.description: A container of valuable industrial minerals used in machine fabrication. Can be sold, traded, or used for high-end crafting.

item.name: Logic Bomb
item.description: A dangerous hacking payload that can disable enemy systems, corrupt terminals, or damage digital enemies.

item.name: Pre-Collapse Relic
item.description: A personal artifact from before the residential deck disaster. Valuable to collectors, historians, and grieving persons
